commands.cmd:
S="$HOME/.local/share/codex-ecosystem/sdk-py313"
sync=$(timeout 60 uv pip sync --dry-run --offline --python "$S/bin/python" adoption/sdk/requirements-linux-x86_64-py313.lock 2>&1) || { echo "DUCKDB_INSTALL_FAIL: uv pip sync --dry-run failed"; printf '%s\n' "$sync" | tail -5; exit 1; }
tag=$(timeout 30 git ls-remote https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb 'refs/tags/v1.5.5' 'refs/tags/v1.5.5^{}' | awk '{print $1}' | tail -1)
ver=$(timeout 60 bwrap --unshare-net --die-with-parent --ro-bind / / --dev /dev --proc /proc "$S/bin/python" -s -c "import duckdb, importlib.metadata as m; v, s = duckdb.sql('select library_version, source_id from pragma_version()').fetchone(); print(m.version('duckdb'), v, s)") || { echo "DUCKDB_INSTALL_FAIL: duckdb did not run"; exit 1; }
python3 - "$sync" "$tag" "$ver" <<'PY'
import glob, json, re, sys
sync, tag, ver = sys.argv[1:4]
dist, lib, source = ver.split()
pins = sorted({w['pin'] for f in glob.glob('catalogs/landscape/*.json') for l in json.load(open(f)).get('layers', []) for w in (l.get('winners') or []) if w.get('component_id') == 'data-duckdb'})
commits = {c for p in pins for c in re.findall(r'[0-9a-f]{40}', p)}
locked = re.findall(r'^duckdb==(\S+)', open('adoption/sdk/requirements-linux-x86_64-py313.lock').read(), re.M)
unchanged = 'Would make no changes' in sync
commit = next(iter(commits)) if len(commits) == 1 else ''
ok = bool(commit) and tag == commit and dist == '1.5.5' and lib == 'v1.5.5' and commit.startswith(source) and locked == ['1.5.5'] and unchanged
print('DUCKDB_INSTALL_' + ('OK' if ok else 'FAIL'), '| winner pin', pins, '| duckdb/duckdb tag v1.5.5 ->', tag, '| sdk-py313 duckdb', dist, 'pragma_version', lib, 'source_id', source, '(prefix of the pin commit:', commit.startswith(source), ') | adoption/sdk lock duckdb', locked, '| uv pip sync --dry-run --offline:', sync.strip().splitlines()[-1])
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
PY
commands.output_excerpt: DUCKDB_INSTALL_OK | winner pin ['v1.5.5; source d8cdaa33fda8df955cc76ef58a280f68f4cd43fa'] | duckdb/duckdb tag v1.5.5 -> d8cdaa33fda8df955cc76ef58a280f68f4cd43fa | sdk-py313 duckdb 1.5.5 pragma_version v1.5.5 source_id d8cdaa33fd (prefix of the pin commit: True ) | adoption/sdk lock duckdb ['1.5.5'] | uv pip sync --dry-run --offline: Would make no changes

commands.cmd:
S="$HOME/.local/share/codex-ecosystem/sdk-py313"
TAG_COMMIT=b236c8194ed14c7a7c685e0534dde501cc855b3a
FILES="tests/fast/api/test_read_csv.py tests/fast/test_parquet.py tests/fast/api/test_read_parquet.py tests/fast/api/test_to_parquet.py tests/fast/api/test_to_csv.py tests/fast/relational_api/test_rapi_aggregations.py tests/fast/test_insert.py tests/fast/api/test_insert_into.py tests/fast/test_transaction.py"
PIN=$(python3 -c "import json,glob,re;p={w['pin'] for f in glob.glob('catalogs/landscape/*.json') for l in json.load(open(f)).get('layers',[]) for w in (l.get('winners') or []) if w.get('component_id')=='data-duckdb'};m={x for q in p for x in re.findall(r'[0-9a-f]{40}',q)};assert len(m)==1,p;print(m.pop())") || { echo "DUCKDB_UPSTREAM_TESTS_FAIL: no winner pin commit"; exit 1; }
D=$(mktemp -d) || exit 1
trap 'rm -rf "$D"' EXIT
timeout 180 git clone -q --depth 1 --branch v1.5.5 https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb-python "$D/src" > "$D/clone.log" 2>&1 || { echo "DUCKDB_UPSTREAM_TESTS_FAIL: clone of duckdb-python v1.5.5 failed"; exit 1; }
head=$(git -C "$D/src" rev-parse HEAD)
sub=$(git -C "$D/src" ls-tree HEAD external/duckdb | awk '{print $3}')
[ "$head" = "$TAG_COMMIT" ] && [ "$sub" = "$PIN" ] || { echo "DUCKDB_UPSTREAM_TESTS_FAIL: checkout $head / submodule $sub do not match $TAG_COMMIT / $PIN"; exit 1; }
mkdir -p "$D/run" && cp -a "$D/src/tests" "$D/src/pyproject.toml" "$D/run/" || exit 1
cd "$D/run" || exit 1
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 timeout 300 uv run -q --no-project --python "$S/bin/python" --with pytest==9.1.1 -- python -c "import duckdb, pytest; print(duckdb.__file__); print(duckdb.__version__, pytest.__version__)" > "$D/where.txt" 2>&1 || { echo "DUCKDB_UPSTREAM_TESTS_FAIL: test environment did not start"; cat "$D/where.txt"; exit 1; }
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 timeout 900 uv run -q --no-project --python "$S/bin/python" --with pytest==9.1.1 -- python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider $FILES > "$D/pytest.log" 2>&1
rc=$?
python3 - "$D" "$rc" "$S" "$head" "$sub" "$FILES" <<'PY'
import collections, re, sys
d, rc, sdk, head, sub, files = sys.argv[1], int(sys.argv[2]), sys.argv[3], sys.argv[4], sys.argv[5], sys.argv[6].split()
where = open(d + '/where.txt').read().split('\n')
log = open(d + '/pytest.log').read()
summary = [line for line in log.splitlines() if re.match(r'^=+ .* in [0-9.]+s', line)]
counts = {k: int(n) for n, k in re.findall(r'(\d+) (passed|failed|errors?|skipped|xfailed|xpassed|deselected)', summary[-1] if summary else '')}
skips = collections.Counter(line.rsplit(': ', 1)[-1] for line in log.splitlines() if line.startswith('SKIPPED ['))
config = [line.replace(d, '<tmp>') for line in log.splitlines() if line.startswith(('platform ', 'configfile:', 'collected '))]
from_sdk = where[0].startswith(sdk + '/lib/') and '/site-packages/duckdb/' in where[0]
configfile = [line.split(':', 1)[1].strip() for line in log.splitlines() if line.startswith('configfile:')]
ok = rc == 0 and bool(summary) and counts.get('passed', 0) > 0 and counts.get('failed', 0) == 0 and counts.get('error', 0) == 0 and counts.get('errors', 0) == 0 and from_sdk and where[1].split()[0] == '1.5.5' and configfile == ['pyproject.toml']
print('DUCKDB_UPSTREAM_TESTS_' + ('OK' if ok else 'FAIL'), '| pytest exit', rc, '|', summary[-1].strip('= ') if summary else 'no summary', '| configfile', configfile, '| duckdb-python v1.5.5 checkout', head[:12], 'with external/duckdb at', sub, '| duckdb from sdk-py313:', from_sdk)
print('skip reasons:', dict(skips), '| upstream files run unchanged:', ' '.join(files), '|', ' | '.join(config), '| duckdb/pytest', where[1])
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
PY
